name: prismical
title: Prismical
description: Search, preview, and capture Prismical notes, or start a recording from your keyboard.
author: nch

commands.title: Search Notes
commands.subtitle: Prismical
commands.description: Find and preview your Prismical notes.

commands.title: Create Note
commands.subtitle: Prismical
commands.description: Capture a note in your Prismical workspace.

commands.name: append-to-note
commands.title: Append to Note
commands.subtitle: Prismical
commands.description: Add text to an existing note.

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording in New Note
commands.subtitle: Prismical
commands.description: Create a fresh note and record in the desktop active workspace.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
